reason: A side-panel web preview plugin for inspecting workspace files, running local projects, annotating rendered elements, and routing links into the preview; its primary user-facing purpose is navigation and preview panel functionality.

summaries.zh: 在侧边面板中预览工作区文件、运行本地项目、标记网页元素并接管链接打开。
summaries.en: A side-panel plugin for previewing workspace files, running local projects, annotating web elements, and handling links within the preview.

capabilities: Serves workspace files for browser preview
Reads and writes files in the workspace, including uploaded drops
Starts and stops local project subprocesses
Exposes local HTTP and JSON-RPC endpoints
Sends logs and element annotations into the conversation
